Jim Corbett, Uttarakhand

Date

A riverside wedding in Jim Corbett: a haldi drenched in yellow, a baraat under old trees, and a varmala beneath white flowers by the water. We stayed close enough to notice what mattered, and quiet enough not to interrupt it.
